sourceText:
Butter Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 11:36pm

Ingredients




2/3 cup soft butter
1 3/4 cups sugar
2 eggs (⅓ to ½ c.)
1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla
3 cups sifted Softasilk flour or 2 ¾ cups sifted Gold Medal flour
2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
1 teaspoon salt
1 1/4 cups milk

Preparation

1 Heat oven to 350 degrees. Grease and flour two layer pans, 9 x 1 1/2 inch or an oblong pan, 13 x 9 x 2 inch. Cream butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla together until fluffy. Beat 5 minutes, high speed on mixer or by hand. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Mix in alternately with milk. Use low speed on mixer. Pour into prepared pans. Bake layers 30 to 40 minutes, oblong 45 to 50 minutes, or until cake tests done. Cool. Frost as desired. Delicious ice with a fluffy white icing sprinkled with coconut or strawberry icing.
